name: sukoon
description: Build-time front-end toolchain for Sukoon (Tailwind CSS, vendored Alpine/htmx) plus puppeteer-core for driving a real local browser during manual htmx/interaction verification. No Node runtime ships in the installer — only the compiled sukoon/static/css/tailwind.css and the vendored JS in sukoon/static/js/ (Dev Spec §5.1, Design System §10.1).

scripts.vendor:js: cp node_modules/alpinejs/dist/cdn.min.js sukoon/static/js/alpine.min.js && cp node_modules/htmx.org/dist/htmx.min.js sukoon/static/js/htmx.min.js
scripts.vendor:fonts: for w in 400 500 600 700 800; do cp node_modules/@fontsource/inter/files/inter-latin-$w-normal.woff2 sukoon/static/fonts/inter-$w.woff2; done
